== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Superlaser (Japanese)|Superlaser]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/135901784/CMVYotEiMkqBOiCN64Jw4Q.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 71262993.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>f3cf7ae0a0fd65237ec98526647ef82e6027f620b9fbc88e5bd9463b9540784a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
